Team —

Thanks again to Tom for taking the time. Quick summary (20-minute call on 8/4/2026):

Tom's relationship to Adele: manager, direct report for ~2.5 years at Nexa (web infra team).

Highlights (3 bullets):
- Technical ownership: Adele led the migration of the templating service to a new framework, owned the rollout plan, and reduced deploy pain by ~30%. Tom called this her "most reliable technical delivery."
- Cross-team collaboration: strong facilitator in design reviews; often bridged product and infra to scope realistic deliverables.
- Growth mindset: accepted feedback on code quality and instituted a lightweight linting + PR checklist that improved team standards.

Concerns / nuance:
- Prioritized speed in a few incidents which occasionally caused rework; Tom said she learned from those and put safeguards in place. Not a performance-red flag, more a coaching note.

Recommendation: Strong hire for senior IC role; Tom recommended focusing interview probes on incident decision-making and how she influences architectural tradeoffs.

- Monica: add consent and notes to the candidate folder.
- Diego: I'll request one additional reference (peer-level) from Adele to round out perspective — will coordinate.

— Diego
